verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships a built-in agent: it builds segments from plain-text descriptions, analyzes the workspace and runs in Slack. Its pricing page also lists AI-generated global styles for messages. Drafting copy is only evidenced through external AI tools: the docs' 'draft messages' and 'Draft a welcome email in Design Studio' examples come from the MCP/CLI pages, not an in-composer assistant. Missing for 10: documented in-composer AI drafting of email copy from a brief, AI subject-line generation or refinement, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
